'''Liselle Gault''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] resident of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At one point, she married the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Orrin Gault]], and they had three children: [[Mullen Gault|Mullen]] and the [[Twin/Legends|twins]] [[Varan Gault|Varan]] and [[Veeka Gault|Veeka]]. Before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Liselle left her husband, leaving the children in his care.
